policy: Median within each process; median of four process medians for times. Geometric mean of four paired process ratios per case. Development family ratios geometric means of case ratios; six development families equally weighted only in labeled suite aggregate. Six evaluation cases reported separately and never pooled. Min/max paired-pass ratios are descriptive ranges, not confidence intervals.
limitations: Development and evaluation populations are separate.
Paired-pass ranges are descriptive, not confidence intervals.
Representative checks sample at most six positive-degree witnesses per degree.
One host and supported build; no universal ranking.
